title: Expressing Obligation & Regret: Kellett volna + Infinitive

sections.title: What Should Have Happened
sections.content: To express past obligation that was unfulfilled ('should have done'), Hungarian uses *kellett volna* governing an infinitive: *El kellett volna mennem* (I should have gone). Negation indicates past mistakes: *Nem kellett volna megvenned* (You shouldn't have bought it).

items.spanish: Jobban oda kellett volna figyelnem az apró részletekre.
items.english: I should have paid better attention to the fine details.

items.spanish: Nem kellett volna olyan hevesen reagálnod a megjegyzésére.
items.english: You shouldn't have reacted so heatedly to his remark.

items.spanish: Már régen meg kellett volna látogatnunk a nagyszüleinket.
items.english: We should have visited our grandparents a long time ago.
